newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks resume rise after Thanksgiving.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks resume rise after Thanksgiving.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed moderately higher in a shortened session Friday as the market shook off losses in the past two sessions after the Thanksgiving holiday.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 22.36 points to 6,521.70. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a margin of 13 to 9 on light volume of 151 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
